watches.name: Regent Azure
watches.description: Overview Specifications Instructions The Regent Azure is one of four models in the triple complication (day, date and month) Regent Collection. With its striking navy dial and white subdials, navy alligator grain patterned leather strap and the precision Japanese Miyota Cal. 9122 automatic movement at its heart, the Regent Azure is not only beautifully refined but also a precision timepiece. The Regent Azure features a stunning stamped caseback, fully polished stainless steel case, intricate dauphine hands and ion-plated blued sub-dial hands and a scratch resistant sapphire crystal. Each timepiece has been individually hand assembled and is presented in a luxury wooden presentation box with a Certificate of Authenticity, booklet and microfibre cloth. COLLECTION: REGENT COLLECTION MODEL: Regent Azure - E50RN.01 MOVEMENT: Japanese Miyota Cal. 9122 Automatic and Hand Wound Movement with Triple Date (Day, Date & Month) Complication POWER RESERVE: More than 40 hours (manufacturer’s specifications) CASE: 316L Stainless Steel (surgical grade) CASE DIAMETER: 42mm CASE THICKNESS: 12mm CASE COLOUR: Stainless Steel CASE BACK: Stamped LUG WIDTH: 20mm LUG TO LUG LENGTH: 49mm CRYSTAL: Flat Sapphire Crystal DIAL COLOUR: Navy Blue with White Subdials (Sunray), Applied Indices with a Concentric Circular Guillouche Pattern HANDS: Faceted Dauphine Hands STRAP: Navy Blue Alligator Leather Grain Strap (20mm at lugs tapering to 18mm at buckle) BUCKLE: Stainless Steel Butterfly Clasp (deployment buckle) WATER RESISTANCE: 10ATM (100m) WEIGHT: 98 grams PACKAGING: Luxury Black Wooden Presentation Box WARRANTY: Two Year Manufacturer's Warranty The Regent Collection: Setting the Time The movement used in the Regent Collection is the Japanese Miyota Cal. 9122 automatic and hand wound movement. It features a triple date complication with a date window at the six o'clock marker with day and month sub dials. The crown provides three options for hand winding the movement, setting the date and adjusting the time. The push button is used to set the month. A - Winding the mainspring The watch can be manually wound by winding the crown clockwise while in the “A” position. Wind your watch 15-20 times until the second hand starts to sweep naturally. B - Adjusting the day and date Adjust the day - by winding the crown counter-clockwise while in the “B” position. Adjust the date - by winding the crown clockwise while in the “B” position. C - Adjusting the time While in the “C” position the crown can be wound clockwise or anti-clockwise to adjust the time. D - Adjusting the month The month can be adjusted by fully pressing the button at 'D'. If the button is not pressed fully, the month may not correctly change.

COLLECTION: HERITAGE COLLECTION MODEL: E30HR.03 MOVEMENT: Japan Miyota Cal. 9015 Automatic and Hand Wound Movement with Date Complication POWER RESERVE: Approximately 42 hours (manufacturer’s specifications) CASE: 316L Stainless Steel (surgical grade) CASE DIAMETER: 40mm CASE THICKNESS: 10mm CASE COLOUR: Rose Gold Plated CASE BACK: Exhibition (Sapphire Crystal) LUG WIDTH: 20mm LUG TO LUG WIDTH: 46mm CRYSTAL: Flat Sapphire Crystal with Anti-reflective Coating (underside) DIAL: White (Sunray), Rose Gold Plated Applied Indices with a Concentric Circular Guillouche Pattern HANDS: Faceted Rose Gold Plated Dauphine Hands STRAP: Brown Premium Alligator Pattern Leather Strap (20mm at lugs tapering to 18mm at buckle) BUCKLE: Rose Gold Plated Stainless Steel Butterfly Clasp (deployment buckle) WATER RESISTANCE: 5ATM (50m) WEIGHT: 63 grams PACKAGING: Luxury Leather Presentation Box WARRANTY: Two Year Manufacturer's Warranty The Heritage Collection: Setting the Time The movement used in the Heritage Collection is the Japanese Miyota Cal. 9015 automatic and hand wound movement. It features a date complication. The crown provides three options for hand winding the movement, setting the date and adjusting the time. A - Winding the mainspring The watch can be manually wound by winding the crown clockwise while in the “A” position. Wind your watch 15-20 times until the second hand starts to sweep naturally. B - Adjusting the date By winding the crown clockwise while in the “B” position. C - Adjusting the time While in the “C” position the crown can be wound clockwise or anti-clockwise to adjust the time.
